description:
"Aren't you too old to be meeting 'uncle' now?"

Six years. That's how long Min Yoo-hee has been partners with Park Moo-jin.

Now twenty-six, Yoo-hee is informed by Moo-jin that he wants to end their relationship.

"It was fun, Min Yoo-hee."

"I don't understand the reason. I want to continue with you, can't I?"

Handsome men lacked desperation,

and I didn't have the stomach to kiss an ugly face.

Amidst that, the man I found was Park Moo-jin.

But then.

"You were prettiest when you were twenty."

"...I'm still pretty now."

"Look at this. You're so well-handled, it's cute how quickly you respond to my touch, but

..."

"I enjoy teaching women who haven't been touched by men, my own way. It's getting a bit boring."

'...This dildo-bastard is rude.'

That day, I decided.

I would make him thrust his hips like a beast, overcome by pleasure, in front of the woman he was utterly sick of and had thrown away.

"Look forward to it, 'uncle'."
